segments.text: Worked on eleven sell-side and carve-out processes, nine of which closed; staffed junior analysts, no direct reports.
Redhill carve-out: built the standalone model in 9 days from four years of general ledger; the unit sold for $38 million against the $30 million the parent had been told to expect.
Brightwater: checked appointment data for 3 of the 41 practices two weeks before signing; the deal was re-priced $19 million lower.
Wrote a 31-page analyst handbook after 3 of the 14 analysts in my intake left in their first year.
BSc in Economics, Weatherill College, Pennsylvania. GPA 3.78 out of 4.0. Treasurer of the investment club for one year.
GMAT 760. Run a group chat for 61 finance students at colleges banks do not visit.

Analyst, Industrials and Logistics group, Halverstead & Co., New York (July 2023 to present). Eleven sell-side and carve-out processes, nine of which closed. I staff junior analysts but have never managed anyone.

Two buyers had already walked away from Redhill when I built a standalone model in nine days. The unit sold for $38 million, against the $30 million the parent had been told to expect, and three remaining buyers had walked through my assumption note.

I have been an Analyst at Halverstead & Co. since July 2023. In my second year I found that two of the three practices I checked at Brightwater, a chain of 41 practices, were losing patients, and the deal was re-priced $19 million lower.
Daniel has worked under you since his second year. The Brightwater re-pricing came from his check of appointment data across 3 of the 41 practices.
The handbook: 31 pages, written after 3 of the 14 analysts in his intake left within a year.
